description: This image displays a modern black leather sofa and a matching armchair, presented against a plain light gray background. The sofa is a three-seater, featuring three plush back cushions and three seat cushions, while the armchair has a single back and seat cushion. Both pieces have wide, flat armrests and low, sturdy block feet, likely made of dark wood. The leather upholstery has a slightly textured, almost matte finish, contributing to a sleek yet comfortable appearance. The overall design is clean-lined and contemporary, suggesting both durability and comfort.
